Around 2002

blocks.source: 女神転生の外伝的シリーズとして、ＳＦＣ後期に発売された。１、２はゲームボーイの作品。
blocks.translation: Released late in the SFC era as a spinoff series of Shin Megami Tensei. The first and second games were released for the Game Boy.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Weight / Story

blocks.source: あらすじ
blocks.translation: Synopsis

blocks.source: かつて、世界では３０年にも渡る戦争が繰り広げられていた。その中で、シャドー・ウォーカーと呼ばれる部隊に所属していたアレク、グレンらは、大きな活躍を果たした。
blocks.translation: Long ago, a war lasting 30 years was waged across the world. During it, Alex, Glen, and the others, who belonged to a unit called the Shadow Walkers, achieved great feats.

blocks.source: そして、戦争が集結し１５年――世界は平和になったように見えた。
blocks.translation: Fifteen years after the war ended, the world appeared to have become peaceful.

blocks.source: がしかし、ラガの村で暮らしていたグレンの元に、戦友アレクが死んだとの訃報が入る。
blocks.translation: However, Glen, who lived in the village of Raga, received word that his comrade Alex had died.

blocks.source: 色々あって、グレンの息子シエル、ルディらは大きな戦いに巻き込まれていく。
blocks.translation: After a series of events, Glen's son Ciel, Rudy, and the others become embroiled in a great battle.

blocks.source: 感想
blocks.translation: Impressions

blocks.source: 本家メガテンシリーズと比較すると、ファンタジーよりの世界観。
blocks.translation: Compared to the mainline Megaten series, it has a more fantasy-oriented setting.

blocks.source: 一見すると、ほのぼのしていて子供向けな雰囲気があるが、メガテン譲りのダークさも併せ持つ。上述したあらすじの通り、この時代のファンタジーＲＰＧとしては異質な設定で、アンバランスながらも、それが魅力的でもある。
blocks.translation: At first glance, it has a wholesome, child-oriented atmosphere, but it also possesses the darkness inherited from Megaten. As the synopsis above suggests, its setting is unusual for a fantasy RPG from this era. Though unbalanced, that is also part of its charm.

blocks.source: 後半のストーリー展開は、序盤の平穏な雰囲気からは想像もつかないような流れに。ＳＦＣのＲＰＧでも、かなり大きな展開をする部類かと思う。
blocks.translation: The story's second-half developments take an unforeseeable turn from the peaceful atmosphere of the early stages. Even among SFC RPGs, I think it is one of the games with especially dramatic developments.

blocks.source: 登場人物も個性的。
blocks.translation: The characters are distinctive as well.

blocks.source: 結構重い世界観なのに、会話のテンションが高いのが何だか独特なノリを作っている。敵側の人物も「不死身の科学者」「都市国家の元老院議員」など凝った設定がついている。
blocks.translation: Despite its fairly grim setting, the high-energy dialogue creates a distinctive atmosphere. Even the characters on the enemy side have elaborate backgrounds, such as an “immortal scientist” and a “senator of a city-state.”

blocks.source: どうでもいいけど、ヒロインの名前が『モチョワ』というネーミングセンスは斬新。由来とかあるのだろうか……？
blocks.translation: This may be beside the point, but naming the heroine “Motyowa” is quite novel. I wonder if there is some story behind it…?

blocks.source: 設定上、ヒロインは主人公と両想いらしいが、主人公が無口なので、その一途さが軽くヤンデレっぽく見えてくるのは気のせいか。ある意味、面白いけど。
blocks.translation: According to the setting, the heroine and protagonist apparently love each other, but since the protagonist is so quiet, is it just me, or does her single-minded devotion come across as slightly yandere? It is amusing in its own way, though.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Usability

blocks.source: メガテンシリーズよりもライト寄りのシステム設計。
blocks.translation: The system design is more lightweight than that of the Megaten series.

blocks.source: おなじみの３Ｄダンジョンではなく、普通の２Ｄ形式のＲＰＧなので、ダンジョンで迷うことはさほどない。
blocks.translation: Since this is a standard 2D RPG rather than the familiar 3D dungeons, it is not particularly easy to get lost in the dungeons.

blocks.source: 悪魔合体によって、仲魔を作ることができるのだが、合体後に継承する魔法を自由に２つまで決められるのは便利。
blocks.translation: You can create demons through demon fusion, and it is convenient that you can freely choose up to two spells to inherit after fusion.

blocks.source: （というか、後のメガテンシリーズ作品にあるランダム継承はどうかと思う。）
blocks.translation: (That said, I have to question the random inheritance found in later Megaten games.)

blocks.source: 戦闘メンバーは６人まで。主人公のシエルとその弟ルディが多くの場面で固定。その他のキャラは展開に応じて頻繁に入れ替わる。
blocks.translation: The battle party can have up to six members. The protagonist Ciel and his younger brother Rudy are fixed members in many scenes. The other characters frequently rotate in and out depending on the story.

blocks.source: 最終的には、その２人に加えて、複数いる人間キャラの中から仲間を１人選び、残りの３人は仲魔（悪魔の仲間）を呼ぶことになる。
blocks.translation: In the end, in addition to those two, you choose one companion from among several human characters, while the remaining three slots are filled by demons (demonic allies).

blocks.source: 個性的なキャラが多いので、できればもっと人間キャラを使いたかった。
blocks.translation: There are many distinctive characters, so I wish I could have used more of the human characters.

blocks.source: 問題点
blocks.translation: Issues

blocks.source: エンカウント率が高い。しかも、逃げにくい。
blocks.translation: The encounter rate is high. On top of that, it is difficult to run away.

blocks.source: 人間キャラの攻撃力が低くて、物理攻撃は使いものにならない。仲魔を憑依させる事で高い攻撃力を得る『ビーストソウル』という武器で主人公だけは何とかなる。しかし、他の仲間は……。
blocks.translation: The human characters have low attack power, making physical attacks useless. The protagonist can manage thanks to the Beast Soul weapon, which grants high attack power by allowing a demon ally to possess him. But the other companions…

blocks.source: 最大ＨＰは４桁に達するのに、最大ＭＰが２５５で打ち止め。
blocks.translation: Although maximum HP reaches four digits, maximum MP is capped at 255.

blocks.source: にも関わらず、消費に見合わない弱い魔法の数々。
blocks.translation: Despite that, there are numerous weak spells whose power does not justify their MP cost.

blocks.source: 無意味に装備アイテムが多い。
blocks.translation: There are too many equipment items for no good reason.

blocks.source: などなど、気になる部分多数。
blocks.translation: There are many other points of concern as well.

blocks.source: 特にエンカウント率の高さは半端ない。
blocks.translation: The encounter rate in particular is absurdly high.

blocks.source: そして、難易度はメガテンシリーズのわりに低めなので、オート戦闘に頼る頻度が多くなる。こうなると、雑魚戦が作業でしかなくなり苦痛となってしまう。
blocks.translation: Furthermore, the difficulty is relatively low for a Megaten game, so you end up relying on auto-battle frequently. At that point, regular enemy battles become nothing more than busywork and turn into a chore.

blocks.source: システムを簡単にして、難易度を下げて、ライトユーザ向けを意識しているように見える。しかし、それでもエンカウント率が高いのは辛い。
blocks.translation: It appears designed with light users in mind by simplifying the systems and lowering the difficulty. Even so, the high encounter rate is painful.

blocks.source: ただ、戦闘はエストマの魔法や、悪魔との会話で避けることができる。一度、仲魔にした悪魔に話しかけると即戦闘終了できる仕様は便利だ。
blocks.translation: That said, battles can be avoided with the Estoma spell or by talking to demons. The feature that lets you end a battle immediately by speaking to a demon you have recruited once is convenient.

blocks.source: なお、敵は弱めなのだが、ラスボスだけは非常に強い。
blocks.translation: The enemies are fairly weak, but the final boss is extremely powerful.

blocks.source: 対策を立てれば、十分勝てる強さだが、今までのヌルさは何だったのかという程に落差がある。
blocks.translation: It is certainly beatable if you prepare properly, but the difficulty spike is so drastic that you wonder what happened to the easiness up to that point.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ後期の作品としては、やや劣る部類だが悪くはない。
blocks.translation: As a late-period SFC title, it is somewhat below average, but it is not bad.

blocks.source: 特に戦闘エフェクトが派手（時々、長いものがあるが……）。
blocks.translation: The battle effects are particularly flashy (though some of them are rather long...).

blocks.source: フロントビューだが、同時代のドラクエと異なり、敵側の魔法エフェクトもしっかり用意されている。
blocks.translation: It uses a front-view battle system, but unlike Dragon Quest titles from the same era, it also has proper spell effects for the enemy side.

blocks.source: マップチップも綺麗なのだが、歩行キャラクターがちょっと微妙かも。
blocks.translation: The map tiles are also beautiful, but the walking characters may be a little questionable.

blocks.source: 具体的には色使いがケバくて、頭身などのバランスが悪い。特に、肝心のメイン２人（シエル、ルディ）の出来が今１つなように思う。
blocks.translation: More specifically, the color choices are garish, and the proportions are poorly balanced. In particular, the two main characters, Ciel and Rudy, seem somewhat underwhelming.

blocks.source: また、レナやメルウといった何度も登場するキャラまで、一般人グラフィックの流用なのはさすがにどうかと。せめて、色ぐらいは変えてくれと……。
blocks.translation: It is also rather questionable that even frequently appearing characters such as Rena and Meru simply reuse the generic character graphics. At the very least, they could have changed the colors...

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: フィールド曲はどれもクオリティが高く、ストーリー進行によって変化する。
blocks.translation: All of the field music is high quality and changes as the story progresses.

blocks.source: 特に魔界のフィールド曲は美しい。戦闘曲も進行に応じて変化する。
blocks.translation: The field music for the demon realm is particularly beautiful. The battle music also changes as you progress.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 子供向けの皮を被ってはいるが、中々に濃いＲＰＧ。
blocks.translation: Although it is disguised as a game for children, it is a surprisingly substantial RPG.

blocks.source: 内容はあるだけに、きちんと調整してリメイクすれば、非常に面白くなりそうな気はする。
blocks.translation: Since it has plenty of substance, I feel it could become very enjoyable if it were properly adjusted and remade.
